title: CCP Margin Monitor
description: Quarterly public benchmark comparing CPMI-IOSCO public quantitative disclosure (PQD) fields across FICC and ICE clearinghouses -- backtest coverage, largest margin deficiency, default fund requirement, Cover-2 peak stress loss, total initial margin required -- using a source-cited fixture dataset, never a live feed.

entity_a.description: First FICC division or ICE clearinghouse to compare

entity_b.description: Second FICC division or ICE clearinghouse to compare

mcp_tool_definition.name: ccp_margin_monitor_compare
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compares CPMI-IOSCO PQD fields across a caller-selected FICC/ICE entity pair using the published Margin Monitor fixture dataset. A field not disclosed by an entity is reported unavailable, never interpolated. Comparison arithmetic only.
